content:
sequenceDiagram
    actor U as User
    participant A as FastAPI
    participant G as Guardrails
    participant H as HybridRetriever
    participant C as Cache
    participant L as LLM
    participant X as XAI

    U->>A: POST /ask
    A->>C: lookup
    alt cache hit
        C-->>A: cached
        A-->>U: fast response
    else miss
        A->>G: safety check
        alt unsafe query
            G-->>A: redirect text
            A-->>U: safety redirect
        else safe
            G-->>A: ok
            A->>H: retrieve
            H-->>A: top-k docs
            A->>L: generate
            L-->>A: answer
            A->>X: score and NLI
            X-->>A: confidence
            A->>C: store
            A-->>U: full response
        end
    end
